communities.name: Lopa villages
communities.note: The LGA of each village is not given; placed in Borgu LGA by the group's areas.

history.text: Ollop is spoken in the main villages of Lopa town, Gafara and Raishe and the smaller villages of Tungan Masu, Bakin Ruwa, Lapar and Ana; Lopa near the Busa have shifted to the Busa language.

reviewNotes: Amboshidi and Tungan Bori are not yet located in GRID3.
name: Lopa

summary.text: The Lopa call themselves Djiri and their language Kirikjir. About 5,000 live around Lake Kainji, with Lopa majorities at Amboshidi and Tungan Bori in Borgu LGA and others in Kebbi State. Those in Borgu are assimilating to Busa.
